correctness.rationale: All essential inferences replayed from stored artifacts with a fresh code path plus independent spot checks. (1) Slice completeness: pair-cover backtracking regenerated 8390 covers (8389 rank-3 + 1 rank-2 single-7-line); full-S7 canonical dedup gives 23 pairwise non-isomorphic types with orbit-sum sum(5040/|Aut|)=8389 and labeled sum 8389; every type passes symmetric basis-exchange. Independently re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py CHECKs 1-3: pair-cover validity + exchange, full-S7 Aut orders + orbit sum, fresh backtrack 8390 — all ok. Independently confirmed no iso pair among 23 via full S7 search. (2) Ternary completeness: all-35-bases normalized scan (B->I3, 4 free columns over 13 PG(2,3) points, 13^4=28561 candidates per basis) is complete since any GF(3)-representation has some basis normalizable to I3; simple-matroid distinctness filter (free columns distinct and not in {e1,e2,e3}) is sound. Verify.py CHECK 4 replays the full scan for all 23 types: exactly types 18,19,20,21 have total frames >0 with allframes {112,108,116,120}=n_bases*4 (n_bases 28,27,29,30); other 19 have 0 frames on every basis, certifying non-representability. (3) Uniqueness: residual labeled-equivalence action fixing a frame basis is the V4 diagonal group (8 diagonal row-scalings modulo overall scalar), correctly implemented as VA; per-basis frames form exactly one V4 orbit for every basis of each ternary type (CHECK 4), hence exactly 1 labeled class; geometric quotient collapses to 1. Independently re-enumerated all bases of the 4 ternary types and confirmed exactly 4 frames per basis. (4) Explicit matrices: repquad-decoded row strings match DRAFT table (18: 1001011/0101121/0011212; 19: 1000011/0101112/0011221; 20: 1001111/0101221/0011212; 21: 1000111/0101121/0011112) and CHECK 5 confirms zero-determinant triples equal claimed nonbases. Distinguishes proof (exhaustive scan = proof) from experiment; no gap found.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors, not timestamp/failed-search. Geelen-Whittle arXiv:1101.4683 proves existence bound f(p) for 4-connected/k-coherent matroids over GF(p) plus structural consequences — no exact 7-point rank-3 per-type counts, uniqueness verdict, or maximizer; rank-3 7-point types are low-connectivity and outside exact scope. Kingan arXiv:1202.2247 defines geometric equivalence (row ops, column scaling, permutations/automorphisms) and a generation method — supplies the equivalence notion used but publishes no 7-point inequivalent-multiplicity table. Mayhew-Royle math/0702316 catalogues all matroids to 9 elements with counts and ternary/binary labels — contains no per-type inequivalent GF(3)-multiplicities, uniqueness classification, or equivalence transcripts; usable only as count cross-check. Live arXiv search 'inequivalent representations matroid' (6 hits) returns only GF(5)/Hydra partial-field work (e.g. 3-connected k=1..6 GF(5) classifications, Brettell et al., Clark et al., Pendavingh-van Zwam confinement/lift Hydra-k) — different field/object. No published GF(3) 7-point uniqueness table or maximizer found. Internal resultary (SCOPE026 8-point Tutte, SCOPE069 8-point ordinary-line minimum with two GF(3) matrices, SCOPE056 exchange diameters) gives isolated witnesses/counts, not per-type GF(3) inequivalent counts on the 7-point slice. The headline invariant (labeled+geometric multiplicities, uniqueness verdict, maximizer tie, explicit matrices + V4 transcripts) is disjoint and not mechanically implied by bounds, method, or database labels.

value.rationale: Independently retrievable exact invariant of a natural object, motivated before computation. Object: simple rank-3 matroids on 7 points — classical first nontrivial window carrying Fano/non-Fano ternary transition and Pappus fragments, a natural classification boundary, not arbitrary slice. Invariant: exact per-type GF(3) labeled/geometric multiplicities + uniqueness classification + explicit representative matrices — motivated by Geelen-Whittle inequivalent-representations program (stabilizers, fragility, representation-search) identified in topic before computation. Value not known or mechanically implied by f(p) bound or database labels; future researcher can cite the uniqueness table for fragility/stabilizer arguments and replay the matrices as coordinatization-search benchmark data. Narrow datum is allowed: rigorously established exact invariant (4 ternary types each multiplicity 1, 19 certified non-ternary, 4-way tie maximizer honestly disclosed as degenerate fallback-level lemma) is precisely the admitted fallback claim judged separately from any larger survey. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration — matrices and equivalence certificates give interpretation and reuse.
